ai.title: Fix cancelled response usage capture
ai.summary: Added `responseStopped` flag in `npm-app/src/client.ts` to ensure usage data is captured for cancelled responses. Moved `promptId` check to reject non-matching actions early. On stop, `unsubscribeComplete` and `xmlStreamParser.end` are called to finalize state.

eli5.text: When you cancel a message mid-way, the app now properly records how much of the response was generated before you stopped it, so your usage stats stay accurate. Previously, the cancellation could cause the app to miss capturing this information. This fix applies to anyone using the app who stops a response before it finishes.
